transcript: The church took 41 years to build, from 1945 to 1986. At 74.5 meters tall, it is the largest church in Iceland. Its design was inspired by the basalt columns that form when lava cools slowly. Inside, a large pipe organ with 5,275 pipes fills the nave with sound. Visitors can take a lift to the top of the tower, where the view stretches across the colorful roofs of Reykjavík to the mountains beyond the bay.
